rows.en:
(Who'd have thought Michel would get scouted
as a model while we were shopping
in the Shibuya Area...)

But are you sure it was okay
to turn them down, Michel?
rows.notes: Male. Player to Michel about the model scout offer.

rows.en: It's no big deal, is it?
rows.notes: x4, Michel to the player, both genders.

rows.en:
Besides, if I did something like modeling,
I'd get even more invitations
from the older ladies than I already do.
rows.notes: x4, both genders. onee-sama-gata = 'the older ladies' as in earlier slices.

rows.en:
Then I wouldn't have any time left to hang out
with you and Alto and the others.
rows.notes: x4, both genders (omae ya Aruto-tachi). The player answers 'What?' (surprised).

rows.en: Come on, let's hurry up and go shopping.

(I kinda wanted to see Michel
as a model, though...)

(But I guess having fun shopping together
like this is better.)

(Who'd have thought Michel-kun would get
scouted as a model while we were shopping
in the Shibuya Area...)

But are you sure it was okay
to turn them down, Michel-kun?

(I kind of wanted to see Michel-kun
as a model, though...)

(But having fun shopping together like this
is better, isn't it?)

(Today I'm gonna enjoy some shopping
with Michel in the San Francisco Area!)
Oh, you made it on time, \p.

Of course I did.
Come on, let's hurry up and go shopping.
Yeah, let's do that.
rows.notes: x8: Michel answering c10341/c10351, both genders.

rows.en:
Come to think of it, word is
the chili dogs here are really good.
rows.notes: x4, both genders. chili dog (glossary: chiri doggu alone).

rows.en: I hear they're so spicy they're addictive.

I bet Klan would burst into tears if she ate one.
Oh, I know, I'll take one back for her.
rows.notes: x4. miyage = take-home souvenir; Michel teasing Klan (female).

rows.en:
Michel...
Don't pick on Klan-senpai like that...
Haha, I'm just kidding.
Well, since we're here, let's have one ourselves.
rows.notes: x4, Michel: eat here before moving on.

rows.en:
(Shopping with Michel was
a nice change of pace today.)
rows.notes: x4: male player, frd_mcl_109/110. 'change of pace' as finished slices.

rows.en:
(Today I'm going to enjoy some shopping
with Michel-kun in the San Francisco Area!)

Of course I did.
Come on, let's hurry and go shopping.
I hear they're so spicy they're addictive.

Michel-kun...
Don't be so mean to poor Klan-senpai...

(Shopping with Michel-kun was
a nice change of pace today.)

(Today I'm gonna enjoy some shopping
with Michel at Folmo!)

Come to think of it, word is
the ice cream here is really good.

Apparently it's made with hippo-cow milk,
so it's sweet and rich.

Klan's got a sweet tooth.
Guess I'll take some back for her.

You can be nice to Klan-senpai
sometimes, Michel.
Hmph. Well, this much is nothing.
rows.notes: x4, Michel, brushing off the compliment.

rows.en: Well, since we're here, let's have some too.

(Today I'm going to enjoy some shopping
with Michel-kun at Folmo!)

Apparently it's made with hippo-cow milk,
so it's sweet and rich.

You can be nice to Klan-senpai
sometimes, Michel-kun.

(I came to see a movie with Michel,
but we still haven't decided what to watch.)

Is there a movie you want to see,
\p?

Hmm, nothing in particular...
How about you, Michel?

Let's see...
While we're at it, how about the revival
screening of "Do You Remember Love?"
rows.notes: x2, Michel. Film title from the song/film glossary entry.

rows.en:
...Come to think of it, Michel,
don't you kind of remind me of
the genius Maximilian Jenius?

Hm? You think so?
That's the first time anyone's told me that.

How do I put it... You've got the same vibe...
Or, like, the same color, I guess...
rows.notes: x2, both genders. karaa ga niteru kept literal as 'color' (likely a nod to both being blue-themed pilots); deliberately vague, Michel answers 'What's that supposed to mean?'.

rows.en: What's that supposed to mean?

Well, whatever. More importantly, if we don't
hurry, we'll be late for the showing.
Right, let's go, then.
Man~, that was a great movie, huh, Michel?

Well, it's kinda lame to talk about the movie
standing around on the street.
Let's talk over some tea somewhere.

(I hope Michel and I can come
see a movie together again.)

(I came to see a movie with Michel,
but we still haven't decided what to watch.)
rows.notes: Female. The Japanese has bare Misheru here (no -kun), so no honorific added.

rows.en:
Hmm, nothing in particular...
How about you, Michel-kun?

...Come to think of it, Michel-kun,
don't you kind of remind me of
the genius Maximilian Jenius?
Right, let's go, then.

Wow~, that was a great movie,
wasn't it, Michel-kun?

(I hope Michel-kun and I can come
see a movie together again.)

Yeah, there's nothing in particular
I want to see either...
Let's just head to the theater and decide there.
rows.notes: x2, Michel, both genders, answering the player's 'nothing in particular'.

rows.en:
(I promised to go see a movie with Michel-kun,
but we still haven't decided what to watch.)
(Now then, what should I have for lunch...)
Phew, I finally got to wash off the sweat...

Hey, Michel.
Did you just take a shower or something?

I came to school straight from my part-time job
today, so I really wanted to wash off the sweat.
That must've been rough.

Kinda.
But there's still one more problem...
A problem?

Fresh out of the shower like this, my sex appeal
shows even more than usual, so the older ladies
won't be able to leave me alone!
rows.notes: x4, Michel. iroke = sex appeal; the player answers 'Yeah, yeah.'

rows.en: Tch, you just brushed me right off...
Oh well, let's go get something to eat.

(Michel's the same as ever.
Now, what should I have for lunch...)
(Now then, what should I have for lunch...)

Oh, Michel-kun.
Did you just take a shower or something?
That must've been rough.

(Michel-kun's the same as ever.
Now, what should I have for lunch...)

uncertain: c10371: karaa ga niteru ('similar color') kept literal; the player is deliberately vague, probably a nod to Max and Michel both being blue-themed genius pilots.
c10378: female inner line has bare 'Michel' (no -kun) in the Japanese; kept bare per the honorific rule.
